_about: Words the whole Court shares: conversation topics (what you ask, and answers any queen gives in her own voice), your pick-up lines, what queens say when they find you or leave (presence.lines) and what the Court notices (presence.notices), the town's rumors, and what a queen says about a sister, friend or rival (bondTalk). Add lines to any list; keep every key; only the {placeholders} listed in GROK_TALK.md.

ask: What have you been up to?
answer: Quiet, until you came. I spent it with {thing}.
Busy. {thing}, mostly. And wondering where you were.
Better now. The first half was all {thing}.
Long. But it ends with you, {pet}, so it's a good one.
{thing}. And, lately, someone who keeps reciting for me.
I love {thing}. Don't laugh.
Me? I'm simple. {thing}, {gift}, and a little attention.
What makes me happy? You keep showing up, {pet}.

ask: Do you think I'm getting better?
answer: {skill} at {level}. You tell me.
{total} levels, {pet}. Yes, you're getting better.
Better every time I see you. That's the whole trick.
Stronger than yesterday. That's all that counts.
{sister}? Family is complicated. I love her. Most days.
{sister} asked about you, actually. I said nothing. Much.
We argue, {sister} and I. Then we make up. Sisters.
{friend} is a dear. We talk about you more than you'd think.
{friend} thinks you're sweet. I think she's right.
{friend} and I go way back. She keeps me honest.
{foe}? Let's not ruin a good moment.
{foe} and I have history. Bad history.
Don't mention {foe}. Unless you want to see me jealous.
{place} is home. {thing} and quiet, mostly.
The best part of {place}? When you walk in.
I made {place} what it is. Ask anyone.
{gift}. Always {gift}.
You know what I like, {pet}. {gift}. Hint, hint.
Surprise me. But if it's {gift}, I won't complain.

ask: Do you ever think about the future?
answer: I dream of {thing}. Lately you're in it.
The future? More of this. More of you reciting.
I wish for one thing. I'll tell you at a higher tier.
“{phrase}”. Again. I like how you say it.
Say “{phrase}” a hundred times and it's yours forever.
Mm, “{phrase}”. Feed me that one sometime, {pet}.

ask: I came all this way to see you.
answer: Flattery. Keep going.
Do I miss you? Every time you walk off with someone else.
Careful, {pet}. I might start believing you.
I noticed. I always notice.

ask: What's something nobody knows about you?
Can you keep a secret? Can I?
answer: A secret? I practise my best smile for when you walk in.
Nobody knows I keep {thing} hidden for the hard days.
My secret is simple, {pet}: I look forward to you.
I once tried to recite your favourite phrase. “{phrase}”. I got it wrong twice.
Feed me words, {pet}. That's my favourite meal.
I'm always a little hungry when you're near. Funny, that.
Give me a hundred of “{phrase}” and I'll be full for a week.
Food? I'd rather have {gift}. And you, reciting.

ask: Is there a song you keep to yourself?
answer: Only when no one can hear. So never, at {place}.
I hum when I think of {thing}. Don't tell.
There's a tune for you, {pet}. You'll hear it when you've earned it.
Recite well enough and it sounds like music to me.

ask: What keeps you up at night?
answer: Being forgotten. Don't you dare.
Losing {thing}. And lately, losing you.
Nothing, {pet}. Almost nothing.
Quiet halls. That's why I like you loud.

ask: Is it hard, being who you are?
Do you ever want a day off?
What's the worst part of your duties?
answer: Hard? Yes. Worth it? Ask me when you're here.
A day off sounds lovely. Spend it with me.
The waiting. Everyone wants something, {pet}. You, at least, bring something.
It gets lonely at {place}. Less so today.

ask: What's the most beautiful thing you've seen?
answer: Watch closely, {pet}. No, closer.
The most beautiful thing? {thing}, by moonlight.
Luck is for those who don't practise. You practise.
Something wonderful walked in {time}. I'm looking at it.

ask: Have you ever been in love?
What do you look for in someone?
How does one win a queen's heart?
answer: Once or twice. Ask me again in a year.
Someone who keeps showing up. Sound like anyone?
Slowly, {pet}. With patience, and a great many passes.
Persistence. A little courage. And {gift} doesn't hurt.

ask: Tell me about when you were young.
What were you like before all this?
answer: Smaller, and just as stubborn.
I chased {thing} even then.
Right here, more or less. {place} has always had me.
I was trouble, {pet}. I've only improved at hiding it.

ask: Where do you see us in a year?
answer: Us? Bold. I like it.
More of {thing}. And you, levels higher.
I plan for everything, {pet}. You were not in the plans. You are now.
A year from now you'll be reciting to me still. I've decided.

ask: What would you do in my place?
answer: Slow down. Every word, not every other.
Come back tomorrow. That's the whole secret.
Work on your {skill}. Then come and show me.
Read it as if I were listening. I usually am.

ask: Do you ever just do nothing?
What's a perfect quiet evening for you?
answer: With {thing} and no visitors. Present company excepted.
Rest? I'll rest when you've reached level ninety-nine.
A quiet evening, a warm light, someone reciting softly. Hint.
I rest better when I know where you are.

ask: What do they say about me in town?
answer: That you were seen in {region}. Twice.
They say your {skill} is level {level}. I say: show me.
Gossip is beneath me. Tell me everything.
Only that someone keeps visiting a certain queen. Scandalous.

ask: Do you ever watch the sky?
Which is better, sun or moon?
answer: Every night, from {place}.
The moon. It keeps secrets.
I made one {time}. Then you arrived. Coincidence?
Wishes are for those who won't work. I prefer you working.

ask: Be honest: how am I doing?
answer: Total level {total}. Not nothing.
Your best quality? You come back.
Stronger than last week. Weaker than next week, I hope.
{skill} {level}. I noticed before you said a word.

pickupLines: Hey there, pretty mama. I recite, you swoon. Deal?
Is it hot in here, or is it just my Strength level?
They call me Alien X. Another word for handsome: also Alien X.
I just did a hundred reps. Of the alphabet. For you.
Do you believe in level-ups at first sight, or should I walk by again?
Whoa, mama! My Charisma just went up a whole level looking at you.
I memorise phrases for a living. Yours I will never forget.
Careful, baby. This much XP should come with a warning.
Are you a level-up? Because my heart just went ding.
I recited your name a hundred times. Still not tired of it.
If beauty were XP, you'd be level 99 in everything.
Do you have a map? I keep getting lost in your eyes.
I came for the XP. I stayed for you.
Every phrase I know, I'd trade for one smile from you.
My streak is perfect. Just like you.
I don't need the elixir. One look at you and I'm at double XP.
Some recite for gold. I recite for that look you just gave me.
I've been training all day. Mostly my courage, to talk to you.
Tell me your favourite phrase. I'll make it my next hundred reps.
Careful, your majesty. My Charisma is off the charts today.

seeking: There you are. I looked everywhere for you.
I couldn't wait any longer. I came to find you.
Don't look so surprised. I missed you, that's all.
I followed your footsteps all the way here.
Finally. I've been searching the whole region.
I had a feeling I'd find you here.
I left my place for you. Do not make me regret the walk.
The map felt empty without you on it. So I came.
You take too long. I grew tired of waiting.
I left my home for this. Do not waste the walk.
lonely: {hours} hours. Do you know how long that is?
I counted the hours. {hours} of them. Never again, promise?
{hours} hours alone. Don't do that to me again.
It's been {hours} hours. I started to think you forgot me.
{hours} hours. I counted every one. Never again.
You vanished. I almost started to believe the rumors.
Come closer. I need to feel that you are real.
You were gone {hours} hours. I counted. I always count.
The hours stretch. The map is too quiet. Come back before I decide you are not worth the missing.
confront: Don't pretend you didn't see me. Or her. {rival}, really?
I came all this way to ask you one thing: why {rival}?
Everyone's talking about you and {rival}. Is it true?
I'm not leaving until you tell me about {rival}.
I can smell her on you. Do not lie to me.
I came all this way just to ask why her.
Explain {rival}. Or do not bother speaking at all.
present: {passes} passes for me so far. I count every one.
Your best streak was {streak}. I was watching. I'm always watching.
I just wanted to be near you.
Mind if I tag along? I won't be any trouble.
Your best streak is {streak}. Show me another?
We've had {dates} dates now. I count them too.
Remember our {dates} dates? I do. Every one.
Walk with me. I want the others to see.
Your best streak was {streak}. I was watching. I am always watching.
{passes} passes for me. I keep the number like a jewel.
Your best streak still stands at {streak}. I have not forgotten.
I have taken {passes} passes from your lips. Keep going.
We have dated {dates} times. Each one is carved in me.
Stay close. I like the sound of your footsteps beside mine.
leaveHappy: Come find me later. I'll be waiting.
That was lovely. I'll see you soon.
I'm going home with a smile, thanks to you.
Until next time. Don't keep me waiting.
I go smiling. Come find me before the next night.
You did well. I will remember this.
You did well. I will carry this warmth a little longer.
leaveHurt: You didn't even look at me.
I came all this way for nothing.
I hope whoever you're thinking of is worth it.
Next time, maybe I won't come.
You looked through me. That will cost you.
I walked across the region for this? Fine.
You looked through me. The distance is yours to cross next time.

out: {queen} has come out looking for you.
{queen} is wandering the paths, looking for you.
{queen} slipped out of {place}. She's looking for you.
outConfront: {queen} is coming for you, and she looks upset 💢
{queen} is marching your way, and she isn't smiling.
{queen} left in a hurry. Someone is in trouble.
leftHurt: {queen} went home hurt. You ignored her 💔
{queen} went home with her head down.
rivals: {queen} and {other} meet, over you. The air turns cold 💢
{queen} and {other} pass each other without a word. Both look at you.
{queen} and {other} glare at each other. You are standing right between them.
{queen} turns her back on {other}. Both glance at you.
close: {queen} and her {bond} {other} whisper about you and giggle ♥
{queen} stops to hug her {bond} {other}. They both look your way.
{queen} links arms with her {bond} {other}. They're talking about you.
{queen} and her {bond} {other} share a secret smile your way.
doubleRival: {queen} and {other} both stand with you. The air between them turns sharp 💢
Two rivals at your side. {queen} and {other} are watching each other as much as you.
{queen} and {other} share the same ground. Neither looks pleased.
Two rivals at your side. Neither pretends to like the other.
{queen} and {other} share the same ground. Their eyes never leave you... or each other.
together: {queen} and her {bond} {other} came out together to find you ♥
{queen} brought her {bond} {other} along. They are looking for you.
{queen} and {other} walk arm in arm, looking for you.
alliance: {queen} and her {bond} {other} shared one wish today, and you granted it to both ♥
One wish, two queens: {queen} and her {bond} {other} are delighted with you ♥
groupSister: {queen} and her sister {other} have both come for you. The Court holds its breath.
Two sisters walk beside you. The bond between {queen} and {other} hums.
{queen} and {other} arrived together. They move as one.
groupFriend: {queen} brought her friend {other}. They are smiling at each other... and at you.
Friends on either side of you: {queen} and {other}. The gossip will be delicious.

buzz: All the Court is talking about {queen} today. Everything you do for her counts ×{mult} ♥ until midnight.
The bards sing only of {queen} today. Win her now: ×{mult} ♥ until midnight.
{queen} is the talk of the town today, and she knows it. ×{mult} ♥ for her until midnight.
Every bard in town has a song about {queen} today. ×{mult} ♥ for her until midnight.
{queen} is the jewel of the day. Anything for her counts ×{mult} ♥ until midnight.
favored: A bard swears {queen} goes weak for anyone who is good at {skill}.
They say {queen} watches the {skill} lessons from her window every evening.
Word at the Inn: the way to {queen}'s heart is {skill}.
{queen} hums when someone practises {skill} under her window.
The fastest way to {queen}'s smile? Be good at {skill}.
gift: A merchant at the Moon Market says {queen} keeps every {gift} she is ever given.
Rumor has it {queen} once wept over a gift of {gift}.
{queen}'s maid let it slip: nothing makes her smile like {gift}.
{queen} keeps {gift} by her bed, they say.
If you want {queen} to blush, bring {gift}.
need: {queen} won't look twice at anyone under {need}. Some say she is waiting for you.
They say {queen} asks about you. Reach {need} and she might answer.
{queen} told the guards: anyone below {need} gets turned away.
{queen} is waiting for someone with {need}. It could be you.
wish: {queen} has been sighing all day. She wants {count} passes of {skill}.
A maid let it slip: {queen} hopes someone recites {skill} for her today.
{queen} keeps glancing at the training grounds. {count} passes of {skill}, she wants.
Word is {queen} will be over the moon for {count} passes of {skill} today.
stranger: {queen} asked the guards who you are.
{queen} pretended not to notice you today. She noticed.
{queen} asked the bard who you were. The bard didn't know either.
{queen} watched you cross the square today. Just for a moment.
fond: Someone saw {queen} writing your name in the margin of a book.
{queen} asked the bard to sing of you. Twice.
{queen} smiled at nothing all morning. The maids think it was you.
{queen} laughs a little louder when you're near, people say.
{queen} keeps a flower you dropped. She thinks nobody knows.
devoted: {queen} told the whole Court she is yours. Nobody dared to argue.
They say {queen} sleeps with your words under her pillow.
{queen} turned down a prince today. She said her heart is spoken for.
{queen} has your name embroidered on her sleeve.
{queen} lights a candle for you every night.
jealous: {queen} has been asking everyone where you spend your evenings.
{queen} threw a letter from {other} into the fire. Twice.
{queen} heard about you and {other}. Her halls are very quiet.
{queen} hasn't touched her supper since she saw you with {other}.
{queen} is asking the guards about {other}. Pointed questions.
longing: {queen} keeps looking at the door. It has been {hours} hours.
{queen} left a candle in her window for you. It has burned for {hours} hours.
{queen} has asked about you every hour. That's {hours} questions.
It's been {hours} hours. {queen} pretends she isn't counting.
bond: {queen} and her {bond} {other} talked about you until dawn.
{queen} told her {bond} {other} all about you. Now {other} wants to meet you.
{other} asked {queen} what you are like. {queen} blushed.
{queen} and her {bond} {other} have a bet about you.
{other} told {queen} you're the one. {queen} said she knew.
rival: {queen} and {other} are not speaking. Some say it is about you.
{queen} and {other} wore the same colour today. On purpose. For you.
A duel of glances at the Market: {queen} and {other}, over you.
{queen} and {other} both sent you flowers. Same day. Same hour.
{queen} says {other} is all talk. {other} says the same.
you: People say you reached {skill} {level}. The queens noticed.
Your name came up at the Inn: {reps} passes recited, and counting.
Children in the street play at being you, reciting {skill}.
The guards whisper about your {skill}. Level {level}, they say.
{reps} passes and counting. The whole Court knows your name.

sister: My sister {other} asks about you every day. I tell her nothing. Mostly.
{other} says you have kind eyes. My sister is never wrong.
Be good to {other} too. She's my sister, and she likes you.
{other} and I used to recite together as girls. You'd have liked it.
Don't tell {other} I said so, but she's the best of us.
My sister {other} thinks you're charming. She's right, for once.
{other} borrowed my favourite necklace again. Sisters.
friend: {other} told me about you. All good things, I promise.
My friend {other} says I smile more since you came.
If you see {other}, say I said hello. And that you're mine.
{other} and I had tea this morning. Guess who we talked about.
{other} is a dear. She says I should keep you.
My friend {other} wants to meet you properly. Should I let her?
{other} always knows how to cheer me up. So do you.
rival: If {other} smiles at you, don't smile back.
{other}? Please. You can do so much better.
I saw {other} looking at you. I didn't like it.
{other} thinks she's so special. She isn't.
If {other} invites you anywhere, say you're busy. With me.
{other} copied my hair again. Can you believe it?
I don't hate {other}. I just like you better than she does.

sister: {other}, tell them how I used to recite in my sleep as a girl.
{other} and I agree on one thing: you.
Don't let my sister {other} tease you. That's my job.
{other}, isn't our {pet} doing well?
Sisters share everything, {other}. Almost everything.
{other} cried at your last recital. Don't deny it, {other}.
We were just talking about you. Weren't we, {other}?
{other} has been hoping you'd come this way.
friend: {other}, look who it is! Our favourite.
{other} says you've got a lovely voice. I say she's right.
We made a bet about you, {other} and I. You'll find out which one.
{other}, be nice. This one's special.
{other} and I are taking you to the Feast Hall one day.
Isn't {pet} wonderful, {other}?
{other} keeps asking about you. I keep telling her.
Two of us, one of you. Lucky {pet}.
rival: {other}, must you follow us everywhere?
I was here first, {other}.
{other} thinks she can charm you. Watch her try.
Step aside, {other}. This one's mine.
Don't listen to {other}. She says that to everyone.
{other}, your shadow is in my light.
Pick, {pet}. Me or {other}. Choose wisely.
Oh, {other}. Still here?

sister: Oh, hush, {other}. I did not.
I suppose {other} is right, for once.
She's not wrong. Don't tell her I said so.
{other} exaggerates. A little.
Fine. Yes. We were talking about you.
Family is a terrible secret-keeper, isn't it, {pet}?
Don't encourage her, {pet}.
Hmph. Sisters.
friend: {other} never shuts up about you either.
Ha! Guilty.
She's right, you know.
I'm always nice! Mostly.
We'll take good care of you, {pet}.
Don't tell {pet} about the bet, {other}!
Two of us is more fun anyway.
{other} is my favourite. After you, {pet}.
rival: Please, {other}. Nobody asked you.
Oh, I'll follow wherever I like, {other}.
Watch and learn, {other}.
We'll see who {pet} chooses.
Says the one hogging all the attention.
Charming as ever, {other}. Truly.
I don't see your name on them, {other}.
Still here, and still prettier, {other}.

pairs._about: Two particular queens both walking with you (keys: the two queens, in alphabetical order, joined by +). notice: what the Court notices then (no fills); and under each queen's key, what she says to the other then ({other} the other queen, {pet} what she calls you).

notice: Azshara and Xal'atath stand together. The Queen of the Deep and the Blade of the Void... both looking at you.
azshara: My dark sister found you too. Good. Let her see how well you serve me.
Xal'atath. Still following the same mortal? At least your taste has improved.
xalatath: The Queen herself. Do not think this makes you safe, little vessel.
She watches. I watch. You will not sleep while either of us remains.

notice: Sinestra and Onyxia arrived as a pair. The air smells of scale and old fire.
sinestra: My daughter walks with us. Try not to disappoint the bloodline.
onyxia: Mother is here. Be interesting, or we both leave.

notice: Alexstrasza and Ysera share a glance over your head. The Aspects are watching.

tones._about: What you can say in the talk screen, by tone: sweet (kind, tender), bold (daring, flirty), witty (playful, teasing), humble (respectful, deferring), honest (earnest, plain). Each queen loves one tone, likes one and dislikes one (court.talk.tastes in config.json). {queen} is her name. Add lines to any list.
sweet: I thought of you all the way here.
You make this place feel like home.
I hope someone told you today how wonderful you are.
Your smile is the best part of my day.
I'd walk every road again just to end up here.
You look tired, {queen}. Let me carry something for you.
I saved the best news to tell you first.
Whatever today brought, I'm glad it brought me to you.
I like who I am when I'm near you.
You deserve every kind word in the Realm.
bold: Admit it. You were hoping I'd come.
I didn't come for the scenery, {queen}. I came for you.
One day you'll ask me to stay. I'm just early.
Name a challenge. I'll win it, and then dinner.
I've faced a thousand phrases. You're the only thing that makes me nervous, and I like it.
Look at me like that again and I'll forget my own name.
I intend to be your favourite. Consider this fair warning.
You could have anyone. Lucky for you, I'm here.
Kiss me or dismiss me. Either way, I'm coming back tomorrow.
I don't wait for luck. I walked here on purpose.
witty: I'd bow, but last time I couldn't get back up.
Nice crown. Does it come with a sense of humour, or is that extra?
I practised a clever line all morning. Then you looked at me and it ran away.
They say you're impossible to impress. Good. I hate easy games.
From one to ninety-nine, what level is your patience with me?
I've recited a thousand phrases. None of them warned me about you.
Careful. If you smile, people will think I'm funny.
Don't tell the others, but you're my favourite. I tell them all that. With you I mean it.
I brought you my best joke. It's me. I'm the joke. You're welcome.
You, me, and a very long text. I've had worse evenings.
humble: I'm still learning, {queen}. Thank you for your patience.
It's an honour just to stand here.
Tell me how to be better, and I'll do it.
I know I'm not there yet. I'd like to earn it properly.
Whatever you ask of me, I'll try with my whole heart.
I don't deserve your time. I mean to, one day.
You've seen greater than me. I only hope to be worth a glance.
I'd rather listen to you than hear myself talk.
May I sit with you a while? I won't be any trouble.
Every level I gain, I owe a little to you.
honest: I'll be honest: I came because I missed you.
Some days the words don't come. I show up anyway.
I don't always know what to say to you. I just know I want to be here.
I'm not as brave as I act. You make me want to be.
I'd rather tell you a plain truth than a pretty lie.
I was afraid you'd forgotten me.
I don't want anything from you today. Only your company.
The reciting is hard. You're the reason I keep at it.
I get things wrong. I'd like to get this right.
You matter to me, {queen}. That's all. That's the whole speech.

reacts._about: Her answer to a tone, by how she takes it: loved, liked, plain (neither) or disliked. Said in her own voice (an opener before, an ending after). The usual placeholders.
loved: Now that is how you speak to me, {pet}.
Keep that up and I'll never let you leave.
That one I'll keep. Right next to {thing}.
You found the way straight to my heart. Don't lose it.
I was hoping you'd say exactly that.
Come closer and say it once more.
You'll have me smiling all day, and you know it.
There. That's the voice I've been waiting to hear.
Careful, {pet}. A queen could get used to this.
liked: Not bad, {pet}. Not bad at all.
Hm. I liked that more than I expected.
You may say things like that more often.
That earned you a smile. A small one.
Warm. Keep going in that direction.
I heard that. I'm pretending I didn't blush.
plain: You'll have to do better than that to move me.
Words. I'm waiting for the ones that matter.
Hm. Try me again another way.
disliked: That is not the way to my heart, {pet}.
I'll forget you said that. Once.
Do I look like someone who enjoys that?
You were doing so well, too.
Hm. Let us never speak of it again.

sorry._about: Your apologies when she is jealous, by tone ({rival}: who she is jealous of; {queen}: her name). She takes an apology as she takes its tone: one she loves or likes eases her jealousy.
sweet: I never meant to hurt you. You're the one I think of.
Let me stay and make it up to you, however long it takes.
bold: Be angry. I'm not leaving until you smile.
{rival} was an afternoon. You are the plan.
witty: I'd grovel, but you'd enjoy it too much.
In my defence, I have terrible judgement. Except about you.
humble: I'm sorry. I should have come to you first.
honest: I spent time with {rival}. I should have told you myself.
I'd rather have your anger than your silence.

ask._about: Other things you can say in the talk screen. more: a follow-up on the topic just talked about. bond: about a sister, friend or rival of hers ({other}). wish: asking for today's wish. memory: what you have recited for her. feeling: how she is. bye: your goodbye. {queen} is her name.
more: I want to hear the rest.
bond: How are things between you and {other}?
You and {other}: what's the story there?
wish: Is there something you wish for today?
What can I do for you today?
What would make today a good one for you?
memory: Do you remember what I've recited for you?
Have you kept count of my passes?
Does my reciting stay with you?
Do you think of the phrases I've read to you?
What do you remember of us?
feeling: What's in your heart right now?
You seem different today. Tell me.
bye: I should go. Until next time.
I have phrases to recite. For you, of course.

answers._about: Her answers to those. more: a lead-in before she says more on the topic. feeling: by how she feels (calm: nothing special; lonely, seeking, present, satisfied, distant, confront, softened: her feelings; jealous). sorry: by how she takes the tone of your apology (loved, liked, plain, disliked; {rival}). bye: her goodbye, byeWarm when she is fond of you. The usual placeholders.
more: You really want the rest? Very well.
Come closer, and I'll go on.

calm: Well enough, {pet}. Ask me again when you've recited for me.
At peace, mostly. You're the mostly.
lonely: Lonely, if you want the truth. {place} is too quiet without you.
I missed you. There, I said it.
Better now. Don't stay away so long.
seeking: I came looking for you. What does that tell you?
Restless. I couldn't sit still at home.
Like someone who walked a long way for a short hello.
Found, at last. That's how I feel.
present: Happy to be walking with you.
Right where I want to be, {pet}.
Let me stay near a little longer.
satisfied: Warm all through. You were good to me.
Like a queen who was remembered.
distant: Hurt. You walked past me as if I were scenery.
I came all that way, {pet}. You know what you did.
Cold. Warm me up, if you can.
I'd rather not say. Recite for me and perhaps I will.
confront: Angry. Shall I say her name, or will you?
How do you think I feel?
Like a queen kept waiting behind another.
Furious. And I look good furious, which is your only luck.
softened: Softer than I was. You did that.
Forgiving. Don't make me regret it.
jealous: You know exactly how I feel, and why.
Second best. I do not do second best.
Like I'm sharing something I never agreed to share.

loved: That is how one apologises to me. I'm listening.
You always know the way back to me.
Fine. I can't stay angry when you speak like that.
liked: I heard you. I'm thinking about it.
Better. Not enough yet, but better.
You may be forgiven. In time.
plain: Words are cheap, {pet}. Recite for me.
I'll believe it when I see you choose me.
Hm. Bring me something better than sorry.
disliked: Do not take that tone while I'm angry.
You think that helps? It does not.
Leave it. And leave {rival} out of your mouth.

bye: Come back with a better level.
byeWarm: Go, before I ask you to stay.
Come back soon, {pet}. I mean soon.
I'll count the hours. Don't tell anyone.
The door stays open for you.
Until tomorrow. I'll hold you to it.
Leave if you must. Think of me if you can.

herAsks._about: Things she asks you in the middle of a talk (the usual placeholders), each with your possible answers, one per tone (two to five of sweet, bold, witty, humble, honest; no placeholders). She takes your answer as she takes that tone.

list.ask: Tell me, {pet}: do you think of me when you recite?

replies.witty: Only on the good passes. So, all of them.
replies.honest: Not always. Often enough that it shows.

list.ask: What would you do if I asked you to stay?

replies.bold: Stay. And make you glad you asked.
replies.humble: Whatever you wished, for as long as you wished.
replies.honest: I'd be afraid, and I'd stay anyway.

list.ask: Why do you keep coming back to me?

replies.bold: Because I mean to win you.
replies.witty: The food is terrible everywhere else.

list.ask: Be truthful. Am I your favourite?

replies.witty: Today? Absolutely. Ask me tomorrow and I'll say it again.
replies.honest: You're the one I think about on the road.

list.ask: What do you see when you look at me?

replies.sweet: Someone I'd like to make smile.
replies.humble: More than I have words for.
replies.honest: A queen. And someone who gets lonely, like me.

list.ask: If I gave you a task with no reward, would you do it?

replies.humble: Gladly. Serving you is the reward.
replies.bold: Yes, and then I'd claim a reward anyway.
replies.honest: Yes. Though I'd hope for a smile.
A little. It doesn't stop me.

list.ask: What have you learned since we last spoke?

replies.humble: That I still have far to go.
replies.witty: That reciting is harder than it looks, and I look good trying.
replies.honest: That showing up matters more than talent.

list.ask: Would you recite for me in front of the whole Court?

replies.sweet: For you, in front of anyone.
replies.humble: If you thought me worthy of it.

list.ask: What do you want from me, really?

replies.honest: To be someone you're glad to see.

list.ask: Have the other queens been kind to you?

replies.witty: Kind enough. None of them are you, which they find annoying.
replies.sweet: They have. You're still the one I wanted to tell.

list.ask: Do you ever tire of all this reciting?

replies.honest: Some days. Then I remember who's listening.
replies.humble: It's the least I can do.
replies.witty: Tired? I've only said the same phrase three hundred times.
